name: green-slime-on-enter-two-buff-counters
notes:
Green Slime (zgcxyky280, ALLY): "On Enter: Put two buff counters on Green Slime." Implemented as enterAbilities['zgcxyky280:0'] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php), a plain AddCounters($player, $mzID, 'buff', 2). Green Slime's element is WIND, not native to the 'Spirit of Fire' starting champion, so the champion's Subcards are patched with a real WIND champion (Spirit of Wind, pNiyaGlIe7) purely to unlock element access -- the same technique already established for deployment-beacon-summon-drone (CanPlayerMeetCardElementRequirements() gates any non-NORM element this way, not only the nine 'advanced' ones).

Green Slime is played for real from hand via a plain FSM action (mode=10002), paying its 3 reserve cost from three of the seven existing filler cards already in hand -- not seeded directly onto the field -- so the Enter trigger genuinely fires per the project's silent-fake-pass rule. Verified live: it materializes at myField-1 with Counters={"buff":2}.

Only the base Enter clause is covered here; the separate [Class Bonus] On Leave transfer clause is covered by its own fixture, green-slime-class-bonus-on-leave-transfer-buff.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Put two buff counters on Green Slime.
